{{translated title|rom}} {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Yambera |characters=ヤンベラ |japanese=Yambera |image=Yambera.png |imagesize=250px |region=Orange Islands |epicode=EP100 |episode=Wherefore Art Thou, Pokémon? }} (Japanese: '''ヤンベラ''' ''Yambera'') is a village located on the eastern part of [[Mandarin Island South]]. It is a little village with many historic buildings, contrasting the modern cities of Mandarin Island South, such as [[Trovitopolis]]. Yambera is known to host annual [[Pokémon Contest]]s. It is the hometown of rivals {{OBP|Ralph|EP100}} and {{OBP|Emily|EP100}}, who are also next-door neighbors. In ''[[EP100|Wherefore Art Thou, Pokémon?]]'', {{an|Misty}} was determined to help Ralph's and Emily's lovestruck Nidoran become a couple. While their Trainers initially disagreed, a battle against {{TRT}} led Ralph and Emily to accept that their Nidoran, who subsequently [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Nidorino}} and {{p|Nidorina}}, respectively, were destined to be together. ==Places of interest== ===Pokémon Center=== {{main|Pokémon Center}} {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} stayed at the local Pokémon Center during their time in Yambera. ===Church=== A Christian church is located in the village center, and is where wedding ceremonies are held for the residents. It appears to be taller than its surrounding buildings. The brown stone building has a bell tower with three bells and a Christian cross on top. Its entrance features a red arch door, and a paved path and hedged garden leads to its entry steps. ==Gallery== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #FFFFFF; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{orange color dark}}" |- style="background:#{{orange color light}}" ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | Ralph's and Emily's houses ! style="{{roundytr|5px}}" | {{color2|000|Pokémon Center}} ! style="{{roundytl|5px}}" | Church |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Yambera houses.png|x170px]] | [[File:Yambera Pokémon Center.png|x170px]] | [[File:Yambera church.png|x170px]] |} ==Pokémon seen in Yambera== {| style="margin:auto; width: 50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Emily|Nidorina|Maria Tony.png|disp=Nidoran♀ → Nidorina|Poison|link=no}} ♀ | {{ActivePoké|Ralph|Nidorino|Maria Tony.png|disp=Nidoran♂ → Nidorino|Poison|link=no}} ♂ |} ==Trivia== * The architecture in Yambera appears to be a mix of early {{wp|Georgian architecture|Georgian style}} and {{wp|Tudor Revival architecture|Tudorbethan style}} construction. ** Due to the heavy influence of William Shakespeare on this episode's plot (an homage to [[wp:Romeo_and_Juliet|''Romeo & Juliet'']]), it is highly likely (but unconfirmed) that the town and its architecture may have been inspired by [[wp:Stratford-Upon-Avon|Stratford-Upon-Avon]], which is where Shakespeare was born and raised. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{orange color light}}|bordercolor={{orange color}} |zh_yue=洋貝拉市 ''{{tt|Yèuhngbuilāai Síh|Yambera City}}'' {{tt|*|Pokémon the Series: The Beginning}} |zh_cmn=洋貝拉市 / 洋贝拉市 ''{{tt|Yángbèilā Shì|Yambera City}}'' {{tt|*|Pokémon the Series: The Beginning}}
